title: Sage terrain_material record
description: A terrain_material record (TerrainMaterialRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another terrain_material record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

layers.description: One to four layers: the first is the ground everywhere, each later one painted over those before it where its rules say. (List<TerrainLayer>)

texture.description: The layer's texture, tiled over the ground. A texture path. (AssetPath)

tile.description: How many metres one repeat of the texture covers. Unit: m. Range: 0.05 to 10000. (float)

minHeight.description: Lies only above this height (not on the first layer) Unit: m. Range: -100000 to 100000. (float)

maxHeight.description: Lies only below this height (not on the first layer) Unit: m. Range: -100000 to 100000. (float)

heightBlend.description: How many metres the layer fades in over at minHeight and out at maxHeight. Unit: m. Range: 0 to 1000. (float)

minSlope.description: Lies only where the ground is at least this steep (not on the first layer) Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 90. (float)

maxSlope.description: Lies only where the ground is at most this steep (not on the first layer) Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 90. (float)

slopeBlend.description: How many degrees the layer fades in over at minSlope and out at maxSlope. Unit: deg. Range: 0 to 90. (float)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.

detail.description: A grey texture tiled finely over every layer: lighter than mid-grey brightens, darker darkens. Empty: none. A texture path. (AssetPath)

detailTile.description: How many metres one repeat of the detail texture covers. Unit: m. Range: 0.05 to 1000. (float, default 2)

detailStrength.description: How much the detail texture shows: 0 not at all, 1 fully. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0.5)

fallback.description: What the ground is drawn with where the splat shader is not available (a build without shaders) Names a material record. (RecordId, default "sage:terrain_default")

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
